title: Episode About the Battle at Anandpur Sahib

blocks.text: The Guru still tries to honor earlier ties, approaching the Lodhi Pathans who had once received gifts and robes from him, but they refuse the burden of loyalty when danger arrives. (53–55)
Rejected at one strong place and unsatisfied with another, the Guru keeps moving until he sights the haveli at Chamkaur that can serve as a defensive stand. (56–57)

The page ends by opening directly into Chamkaur: the haveli is entered with a few Singhs and the elder Sahibzadas, Malerkotla forces close in, and the next great battle begins. (Episode 19, 1–3; Chamkaur)
